what: The cut list of film B, with the opening of film A and the card loop. Made by npm run cut from film.units, film.beats, the narrator's film lines and the events of the whole film run in film mode. Frames are counted from 0 at film.fps.

lines.text: Here we find / the applicant. / Rent is due.
It spots unlimited PTO. / Poor thing / believes it.
First name. / Under fire. / Standard onboarding.
Hit. / It keeps typing. / It has bills.
A valid email. / Rejected. / The system / is working as designed.
It fights for the resume. / Two pages. / One of them is true.
A rotary phone. / The applicant / has never seen one.
Volume. / All the way up. / It will regret that.
The skills assessment. / No skills / will be assessed.
A career. / In reverse.
Corporate headquarters. / So close.
It runs on coffee / and fear.
Someone / hit reply all.
Fired. / Before it was hired. / A new record.
The unemployment office. / It knows the way.
Not a robot, / it claims. / We will see.
The submit button fights back. / Even it / does not want this job.
Session expired. / A classic.
Rejected. / In under a second.
It will apply again tomorrow. / They always do.
